_source: Shape of an engine-instance Orphan as Longhorn v1.13.0 creates it. No live orphan existed to copy, so it is built from Longhorn's own code at tag v1.13.0:

https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/k8s/pkg/apis/longhorn/v1beta2/orphan.go (OrphanSpec json keys nodeID, orphanType, dataEngine, parameters; OrphanTypeEngineInstance = "engine-instance"; parameter keys OrphanInstanceName = "InstanceName", OrphanInstanceUUID = "InstanceUUID", OrphanInstanceManager = "InstanceManager"; condition types InstanceExist, Error)

https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/controller/instance_manager_controller.go (InstanceManagerMonitor.createOrphan: NodeID = the monitoring manager's node, Parameters = {InstanceName: the engine process name, which is the Engine CR's name (isEngineOrphaned looks the CR up by it), InstanceUUID, InstanceManager: the IM's name}; name from types.GetOrphanChecksumNameForOrphanedInstance)
https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/types/types.go (GetOrphanLabelsForOrphanedEngineInstance: the labels the mutating webhook attaches; orphanPrefix = "orphan-")
Names, uids and timestamps are placeholders.
